# Elyamani Hamid — Web Developer, Marrakech

> Freelance full-stack web developer based in Marrakech, Morocco. I build

## Services

- Websites & web platforms: professional showcase sites, e-commerce,
  booking systems, dashboards — fast, secure, built to convert visitors
  into customers.
- AI integration & automation: recommendation engines, chatbots, content
  generation, workflow automation (OpenAI, scikit-learn).
- Complex problem solving: diagnosing and fixing slow apps, fragile
  architectures, performance, security and scalability issues.

## Selected projects

- Postra: AI social media management SaaS — AI post generation, scheduling
  across 6 platforms, analytics. Built full-stack (Next.js, Laravel, OpenAI).
  Used by 450+ marketers — live at https://postra.io
- Dropleather: custom leather goods dropshipping platform serving 200+
  brands — full front-end (Framer marketing site + React app interface).
  Live at https://dropleather.com
- Roomly: housing reservation platform with ML-powered recommendations
  (Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, scikit-learn).
- Pixo: real-time collaborative drawing platform (Next.js, Socket.IO,
  Konva) — live at https://pixospace.onrender.com
- TAMAIOZ: private-lessons platform with booking, messaging and virtual
  rooms (React, PHP, MySQL).
- OLINO: e-commerce store for traditional Moroccan clothing (Laravel, MySQL).
- Ebooksy: online library of 400+ e-books with AI recommendations
  (WordPress, OpenAI API) — live at https://ebooksy.site
